body.zh-HK:
> 面試官問：「團隊說 causal attention mask 已經令 assistant 看不到『未來資料』，所以把任何檢索文件放進 prompt 都安全。你會怎樣回應？」
>
> 答啱一半嘅答案：「mask 會把未來 token 遮住，模型不能偷看後面的文字。」

## Mask 真正控制的是甚麼

在 autoregressive transformer 裡，causal mask 會把不應被目前位置注意到的 attention score 壓低，令生成第 t 個 token 時不能直接用第 t+1 之後的 token。它是模型計算圖中的位置限制：同一段 sequence 內，哪個 token 可以向哪個 token 看。這個限制對 next-token generation 很重要，但它完全不知道一段文件是否獲授權、是否屬於正確租戶、是否已過期、是否含有不應交給模型的資料，或是否應該支持目前這個決定。

如果一個未獲授權的 HR 文件、過期的 policy 或另一個客戶的資料在 prompt 組裝時已經被放進前面，causal mask 不會把它取走。模型仍可注意它、摘要它、引用它，甚至只在輸出語氣中漏出訊號。更嚴格的 mask 也無法把「資料可以被讀」和「資料可以用來回答這宗問題」區分開來。資料權限、context assembly 和工具權限必須在模型之前、之外執行。

## 舞台幕布不是出入證

舞台上的黑幕可以遮住下一幕的佈景，令演員暫時看不到；它卻不是場地保安。拿著錯門票的人仍然可能已經走進後台。attention mask 是黑幕，不是門禁卡。

## 答案在哪裡會變薄

不要因為懂 attention 就立刻設計多層 agent。對一個只回答公開、版本固定文件的 prototype，先做明確 allowlist、單一 static corpus、沒有寫入工具和每個答案必帶 source ID，已是較安全的 baseline。只有當真有多個資料範圍時，才加可檢查的 subject、role、tenant、purpose 和 expiry filter。

## 技術判斷：分開計算可見性與資料資格

你可以展示一個很小的 attention-mask test：固定 sequence 的 score matrix 中，位置 t 對 t+1 的權重必須被禁止；這只驗證模型層面的可見性。另一組完全獨立的測試應驗證 source eligibility：request 的 subject、role、purpose、資料分類、有效期與 source owner 是否容許該文件進入 context。若任一項不符，文件 ID 不可進 candidate list，不是「放入後叫模型不要用」。

context receipt 應保留最少必要資料：request ID、policy version、允許／拒絕 source ID、拒絕理由、source version 和 expiry check。它比儲存整段 prompt 更能支援調查。對有敏感內容的環境，還要明確設定 log redaction、review route 和資料刪除條件。

## 工程層面：把門放在 prompt 之前

一個簡單流程可以是：驗證 request identity 與 purpose → 查詢只回傳 metadata 和已允許 source → 驗證 freshness／effective date → 組裝最小 context → 生成草稿 → 檢查引用只指向已允許 source。retrieval、rerank 和生成都只能處理前一步已准許的集合。若可用集合是空的，正確行為可能是拒絕、要求補充權限或交人手，而不是擴大搜尋範圍。

另外要留意工具。即使文字 context 全部公開，工具 schema 仍可能讓模型讀取或寫入別的資料。模型的 attention mask 不會限制 HTTP request、database query 或 downstream action；這些要由獨立的 service-side authorization 和最小權限 capability 控制。

## 交付、業務與風險：一個拒絕也可以是成功結果

資料 owner 要定義誰在何種目的下可使用哪類來源；產品 owner 要決定使用者看到「未授權／資料不足」時的明確下一步；review owner 要處理例外，而不是讓模型猜。量度上要看 deny rate、錯誤允許、過期來源被阻止的比例、citation 是否能追到來源版本、以及例外處理所需時間。不要把較低的拒絕率誤認為產品更好，因為放寬權限可能只是把風險藏起來。

## 可放進 portfolio 的 artefact

建立 attention-is-not-authorisation-lab：

- docs/boundary-map.md：畫出 attention visibility、retrieval eligibility、tool permission 三條不同邊界。
- fixtures/mask-matrix.json：固定小型 score matrix，驗證 future positions 被遮住。
- fixtures/source-cases.json：完全合成的 public、expired、wrong-role、wrong-tenant 和 no-purpose 文件 metadata。
- tests/admission-matrix.md：每項 request 的 expected allowed IDs、denied reason、citation rule 和 handoff。
- docs/decision-record.md：說明為何 prototype 只用 static allowlist，何時才值得引入更複雜的 policy engine。

## 延伸閱讀

[RAG：檢索、生成還是權限問題？](/zh-HK/interview-lab/rag-retrieval-generation-or-permission)、[把不可信文件當資料處理](/zh-HK/interview-lab/treat-untrusted-documents-as-data) 和 [長 context 不是免費升級](/zh-HK/interview-lab/long-context-is-not-a-free-upgrade)。

## 範圍說明

這是 AI.DOG 的單題練習。所有文件、角色、policy 和測試結果均為虛構或 synthetic fixture；它不是資安意見、公司架構描述、真實資料存取證明或招聘預測。

body.en:
> Interviewer asks: “The team says a causal attention mask prevents the assistant from seeing ‘future data’, so it is safe to put any retrieved document into the prompt. How would you respond?”
>
> Half-right answer: “The mask hides future tokens, so the model cannot peek at the text that comes later.”

## What a mask actually controls

In an autoregressive transformer, a causal mask suppresses attention scores that a position is not allowed to use. When generating token t, the model cannot directly attend to tokens after t. That is a positional constraint inside the model's computation graph: which token may look at which other token in one sequence. It matters for next-token generation, but it knows nothing about whether a document is authorised, belongs to the right tenant, has expired, contains material that must not reach the model, or is appropriate evidence for this decision.

If an unauthorised HR document, an expired policy, or another customer's record was already placed before the answer in prompt assembly, a causal mask will not remove it. The model can still attend to it, summarise it, cite it, or leak its signal through an answer's wording. A stronger mask cannot distinguish “the model can read this data” from “this data may be used to answer this request”. Data permission, context assembly, and tool permission have to be enforced before and outside the model.

## A stage curtain is not an access card

A theatre curtain can hide the next scene from an actor. It is not a building guard. Someone with the wrong ticket may already have walked backstage. An attention mask is the curtain, not the access card.

## Where an answer goes thin

Knowing attention does not mean that a prototype needs a multi-agent policy stack. For a system answering only public, version-fixed documents, begin with an explicit allowlist, one static corpus, no write tools, and a source ID on every answer. Add inspectable subject, role, tenant, purpose, and expiry filters only when the product truly has multiple data scopes.

## Technical judgement: test visibility and eligibility separately

You can show a small attention-mask test: in a fixed score matrix, position t must be prevented from assigning weight to position t+1. That verifies model-level visibility only. A separate test suite should validate source eligibility: does the request's subject, role, purpose, data classification, effective date, and source owner permit this document to enter the context? If any check fails, the document ID must not enter the candidate list. “Put it in and tell the model not to use it” is not a control.

A context receipt should retain the minimum evidence needed to investigate: request ID, policy version, allowed and denied source IDs, denial reason, source version, and expiry check. It is more useful than storing the whole prompt. In a sensitive setting, specify log redaction, a review route, and deletion conditions too.

## Engineering implementation: place the gate before the prompt

A small pipeline can be: verify request identity and purpose → query only permitted source metadata and content → verify freshness and effective dates → assemble the minimum context → generate a draft → verify that citations point only to admitted sources. Retrieval, reranking, and generation can only operate over the permitted set from the previous step. If that set is empty, the correct result may be refusal, a request for additional authority, or human handoff—not a wider search.

Tools need their own boundary. Even if all text context is public, a tool schema may allow the model to read or write other data. An attention mask does not constrain an HTTP request, database query, or downstream action. Those need independent service-side authorisation and least-privilege capabilities.

## Delivery, business, and risk

A data owner defines who may use each source class and for which purpose. A product owner defines the next step when a user sees “not authorised” or “insufficient evidence”. A review owner handles exceptions rather than asking the model to guess. Measure denial rate, incorrect admission, expired-source blocks, whether citations resolve to the intended source version, and exception turnaround. A lower denial rate is not automatically a better product; it may only mean that risk has been hidden.

## A portfolio artefact someone can inspect

Build attention-is-not-authorisation-lab with:

- docs/boundary-map.md: the distinct boundaries for attention visibility, retrieval eligibility, and tool permission.
- fixtures/mask-matrix.json: a fixed small score matrix that proves future positions are masked.
- fixtures/source-cases.json: fully synthetic public, expired, wrong-role, wrong-tenant, and no-purpose document metadata.
- tests/admission-matrix.md: expected allowed IDs, denial reason, citation rule, and handoff for each request.
- docs/decision-record.md: why the prototype begins with a static allowlist and what evidence would justify a more complex policy engine.

## Further reading

[RAG: a retrieval, generation, or permission problem?](/en/interview-lab/rag-retrieval-generation-or-permission), [treat untrusted documents as data](/en/interview-lab/treat-untrusted-documents-as-data), and [long context is not a free upgrade](/en/interview-lab/long-context-is-not-a-free-upgrade).

## Scope note

This is an AI.DOG single-question practice exercise. Every document, role, policy, and test result is fictional or a synthetic fixture. It is not security advice, a company architecture description, proof of access to real data, or a hiring prediction.
